newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: ING Baring to lead Czech Ostrava bond - agency.
newsitem.headline: ING Baring to lead Czech Ostrava bond - agency.

text.p: ING Baring will lead manage a 75 million mark, five-year bond issue by the city of Ostrava, the CTK news agency quoted a senior city official as saying.

CTK quoted Ostrava Deputy Mayor Milan Balaban as saying the city received 30 offers from domestic and foreign institutions for the bonds, which will carry a coupon of six-month LIBOR plus 30 basis points.
Balaban said the bonds will be listed on the London market and will be issued when the city feels market conditions are suitable.

The city will use funds from the issue to help refinance its 707 million crown debt to savings bank Ceska Sporitelna, and help finance the construction of a sewage cleaning facility scheduled for next year, as well as a "development investment", Balaban said.
Ostrava is the third largest city in the Czech Republic, located in the heavily industrialised area of northern Moravia.
